title: Homeservers which have been upgraded from (oldish) sqlites can get stuck looping(?) trying to retrieve thousands of events one by one
body:
from #synapse-dev on 2018-03-29:
> meanwhile, arasphere.net is doing stuff like

> ...with then 3000 GET /events
which surprises me as i thought we had a bulk API for getting state
